campaign_name: Meelte Ads Launch - The 60-Second Flash Deal
objective: Educate local shopkeepers and retail owners on how to create a Single Item ad with instant discount badges in under 60 seconds on meelTe.
target_audience: Local small-business owners, retail shopkeepers, boutique owners, bakeries
key_message: Post a flash deal in under a minute and reach nearby customers directly with zero listing fees and no approval delays.
headline: Got a deal to share today?

dialogue_or_voiceover.text: Got a product you want to sell fast today? Don't wait for foot traffic.
Open meelTe, tap the plus sign, and snap a clear photo.
Add your price, pick your discount badge, and pin your store on the map.
Hit create! No waiting for approvals—your deal goes live to nearby shoppers right now.
Put your shop on the map. Try meelTe free today!

audio_direction.music: Warm, light, cheerful acoustic guitar rhythm with bouncy beat, ducked -14dB under voiceover.

sfx.description: Subtle UI pop when discount badge attaches
Gentle upward chime when ad publishes
Warm acoustic resolve chord on logo card

required_elements: Flat vector 2D illustration style + clean app UI mockups
9:16 safe area compliance for captions and UI overlays
prohibited_elements: No invented discounts or fake testimonials
No generated logo (use reserved zone / deterministic lockup)
No spelling variants like Meelte or MEELTE
